propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% consumed by the reconciler's .bridge_state cache; only 55 MB is actual ticket event data, causing wasteful growth through uncommitted bookkeeping fields

Scattered edits to the sort-ordered 18 MB bindings.json file defeat git delta compression; marginal cost per version is 12.79 KB today and can be reduced 7.4x by removing the baseline_advanced_at timestamp and 12.8x total by moving rotation bookkeeping
The .bridge_state cache must remain on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners; the solution is to reduce content churn and storage footprint, not relocate the cache off-branch

A git fast-export filter-import pipeline can reclaim ~1 GiB of historical bloat while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges; the rewritten HEAD tree remains byte-identical to the pre-rewrite tip

Multiple committed-format changes (delete baseline_advanced_at, move last_get_pass to sidecar file, normalize baseline fields, narrow prev_snapshot.json) must be coordinated with mixed-version read compatibility and rollback procedures before history rewrite execution
